name: Metformin
indications: First-line treatment for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Reduces hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity in peripheral tissues.
mechanism: Activates AMPK (AMP-activated protein kinase), inhibiting mitochondrial complex I, thereby reducing gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis in the liver.

name: Lisinopril
indications: Treatment of hypertension, heart failure, and post-myocardial infarction.
mechanism: Inhibits angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE), preventing conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II.

name: Atorvastatin
indications: Hypercholesterolemia and cardiovascular disease risk reduction.
mechanism: Competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme in hepatic cholesterol synthesis.
warnings: Discontinue if unexplained muscle pain occurs

name: Napa
indications: Relief of mild to moderate pain and fever. Commonly used for headache, toothache, muscle pain, and cold/flu symptoms.
mechanism: Inhibits cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes in the central nervous system, reducing prostaglandin synthesis to lower pain perception and body temperature.

name: Amoxicillin
indications: Bacterial infections including upper/lower respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, skin infections, and dental abscesses.
mechanism: Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis by binding to penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs), disrupting peptidoglycan cross-linking.

name: Omeprazole
indications: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcers, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, and H. pylori eradication (in combination therapy).
mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits the H+/K+ ATPase proton pump in gastric parietal cells, blocking the final step of acid secretion.
warnings: Long-term use may increase risk of bone fractures
Risk of hypomagnesemia with prolonged use

name: Cetirizine
indications: Allergic rhinitis (seasonal and perennial), chronic urticaria, and other allergic conditions.
mechanism: Selective antagonist of peripheral H1 receptors, blocking histamine-mediated allergic responses without significant CNS sedation.
warnings: May cause drowsiness in some patients

name: Losartan
indications: Hypertension, diabetic nephropathy in type 2 diabetes, and stroke risk reduction.
mechanism: Selectively blocks AT1 receptors, preventing angiotensin II from causing vasoconstriction and aldosterone secretion.

name: Salbutamol
indications: Acute bronchospasm relief in asthma and COPD. Prevention of exercise-induced bronchospasm.
mechanism: Activates beta-2 adrenergic receptors in bronchial smooth muscle, causing relaxation and bronchodilation via increased intracellular cAMP.
dosage: 100mcg – 200mcg (1-2 puffs) inhaled, every 4-6 hours as needed
warnings: Increasing use may indicate worsening asthma

name: Amlodipine
indications: Hypertension and chronic stable angina pectoris.
mechanism: Inhibits calcium ion influx through L-type calcium channels in vascular smooth muscle, causing vasodilation and reduced peripheral resistance.
warnings: Use caution in severe aortic stenosis
May worsen heart failure in some patients
